verdict.rationale: Codegen advertises a Figma integration and the ability to work from natural-language prompts/requirements via Slack or Linear without needing an engineer to write code, which supports a no-handoff workflow. However, there is no concrete documentation of an actual mockup-to-code pipeline, no case study of a PM taking a design straight to a merged implementation, and no detail on how Figma designs are translated into working UI. Missing for 10: an explicit Figma-to-code workflow, PM-oriented tutorial/case study, and evidence of end-to-end mockup ingestion producing a working implementation without engineering involvement.
